images.alt: Anna Jarvis, founder of Mothers Day in the United States.
images.caption: Anna Jarvis (1864-1948) fought to establish Mothers Day as a national holiday in 1914, honoring her mother Ann Reeves Jarvis.
The Civil War killed an estimated 620,000 to 750,000 soldiers. Julia Ward Howe saw the devastation and demanded an end to war.
